subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – lesson videos not playing
body_text:
Hi Meera,

Thank you for speaking with us. You came to us because some of your students' lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones. I'm sorry for the trouble, especially as this is the third time you have raised it.

What we went through:
- We opened the affected lesson on desktop Chrome, Safari and a phone, and the video played fine each time, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side. This is not resolved yet.

What you need to do next:
1. Ask one of the affected students to record a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.

What we'll do next:
- We will raise the video loading problem with our technical team and get back to you. We could not give a timeline during the call.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-03

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
